title: Budget and Revenue
text:
This page explores the relationship between film production budgets and box office revenue.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"], alpha=0.5)
plt.xlabel("Budget")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("Budget vs. Revenue")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Relationship between film production budget and box office revenue

title: Box Office Numbers
text: This website explores a dataset of films released between 1980 and 2025, including production budgets, worldwide box office revenues, runtimes, and IMDb ratings. Financial figures are approximate, reported in millions of US dollars, and are not adjusted for inflation. The analyses examine relationships between film characteristics, ratings, and box office performance.

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
This page examines the relationship between film runtime and IMDb ratings.
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"], alpha=0.5)
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating")
plt.title("Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating

title: The Bond Films
text:
This page explores how James Bond film revenues have changed over time.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

The James Bond films in this dataset span from 1995 to 2021.

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue")
plt.title("James Bond Revenue Over Time")
plt.show()







Figure 1: James Bond film revenue over time
